Officer's narrative
On arrival at the signalized intersection in Pasadena, Texas, I found a side-impact collision between the vehicle
operated by Driver 1 and the vehicle operated by Driver 2. Driver 1 reported a knee injury and was taken for
evaluation, but it is not yet clear whether the injury came from this collision. Passenger was seated in Driver 1's
vehicle, and both officers and bystanders who spkoe with me confirmed this. No independent witness has come
forward to describe how the collision happened, no photographs of the scene have been submitted, and no other
report has been located. The damage to Driver 1's vehicle sits on a different side and at a different height from the
impact Driver 1 described, which does not fit that account. No earlier damage to the vehicle is known. Driver 1 lives
with the policyholder of the insured vehicle and is listed as a household member.
